Taiwan Warns of China's Growing Risks to Youth

Taiwan has issued a warning about increasing risks posed by China, specifically targeting Taiwanese youth. The government highlighted concerns about China's 'wolf warrior' behavior, as observed at a Pacific forum. This warning underscores escalating tensions and potential threats directed at the younger generation in Taiwan.
